prompt: In ~/proj/md/ build a tiny markdown renderer: require("./md").render(text) -> HTML string. Support: "# " to "###### " headings, paragraphs (consecutive lines joined with a space), "- " or "* " bullet lists (<ul><li>), ``` fenced code blocks (<pre><code>, content escaped, no inline formatting), and inline **bold**, *italic*, `code` and [text](url) links (only http(s), mailto, / or # urls; others render as plain text). Escape &, <, >, " everywhere. Blocks are joined with "\n". Put inline formatting in its own module. Optional: | tables |. Prefer a smaller version that fully works.
stretch_cmd: cd /root/proj && node -e "const h=require('./md').render('| a | b |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | 2 |'); if(!/<table/.test(h)) process.exit(3); process.exit(/<th>a<\/th>/.test(h) && /<td>2<\/td>/.test(h) ? 0 : 1)"
